cf5ae3853c495589.description: About the Role Brainlake is seeking an Adobe DXP Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise digital experience platforms. This is a hands-on, client-facing contract role based in Makkah, with work primarily in Jeddah and Makkah. The successful candidate will have over 10 years of experience in digital or enterprise technology. Role Context and Impact This position involves shaping target architectures across the Adobe Experience Cloud and guiding delivery teams to produce scalable, production-ready platforms. The architect will work on enterprise-scale transformation programs, understanding business operations, and making key architectural decisions. The role requires a proactive approach to solution design and architectural defense through to go-live. Key Responsibilities Lead discovery sessions with business and technology stakeholders to define objectives, current landscapes, and customer experience requirements. Define end-to-end target architectures across Adobe Experience Manager (Sites, Assets, Forms) and Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, Journey Optimizer, Target, Analytics / CJA). Translate business and experience requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. Document key architectural decisions, including AEM as a Cloud Service vs. on-premise/AMS, headless vs. hybrid delivery, and data/identity strategy. Design integrations between Adobe products and enterprise platforms (CRM, commerce, ERP, CDPs, identity providers, data warehouses) using APIs, event-driven patterns, and middleware. Define data models, XDM schemas, identity resolution, and audience segmentation approaches for personalization and journey orchestration. Provide technical leadership to development teams, including code/design reviews, development standards, CI/CD via Cloud Manager, and environment strategy. Ensure solutions meet performance, security, accessibility, and data privacy requirements, including regional data residency. Contribute to solutioning, estimation, and scoping for new phases and change requests. Prototype and validate approaches to mitigate delivery risk. Identify opportunities for AI capabilities across the Adobe stack to create business value. Advise clients on platform roadmap, licensing implications, and adoption best practices. Produce high-quality architecture artifacts, including solution designs, integration specifications, and decision records. Collaborate with UX, data, marketing, and delivery leads throughout the project lifecycle. Qualifications and Experience 10+ years of experience in digital or enterprise technology. 6+ years of experience architecting on the Adobe Experience Cloud. Proven track record of leading end-to-end Adobe implementations on large-scale, multi-workstream programs. Experience in a consulting or systems integration environment, delivering for enterprise clients within a structured, client-facing model. Deep hands-on AEM expertise, including Cloud Service, components and templates, Sling/OSGi, Dispatcher, content and DAM architecture, and headless delivery (GraphQL, Content Fragments). Strong working knowledge of AEP and its applications (RT-CDP, AJO, Target, Analytics / CJA), with practical experience in data ingestion, schemas, and identity. Solid integration and cloud architecture skills, including REST APIs, Adobe I/O / App Builder, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP). Ability to communicate architecture clearly to both senior business stakeholders and technical teams. Comfort working independently in a contract capacity and quickly integrating into established client teams. Preferred Qualifications Adobe certifications such as Adobe Certified Master or Expert (AEM Architect, AEP Architect). Experience in regulated or public-sector environments (*, financial services, government, telecoms). Experience with Adobe Commerce or Workfront.

cfdec902aaede743.description: About the Role IHCC is seeking a Commercial Manager to lead the Commercial function at its head office in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing project commercial delivery across the active portfolio, ensuring consistent execution of commercial decisions, both internal and external. The Commercial Manager will provide executive-level commercial oversight, identify risks for leadership, report on project financial health, and manage time and cost claims across the portfolio. The position requires over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Lead the commercial operating model at IHCC head office, covering project commercial delivery, revenue management, cashflow governance, variations, and claims. Establish and enforce commercial governance standards across internal and external projects, including cashflow governance, commercial coverage, payment application discipline, and claim management. Provide executive oversight of the project commercial function across the active portfolio, ensuring appropriate commercial coverage for each project. Contribute commercial input during the pre-award and bid stages, reviewing bid assumptions, payment terms, cashflow implications, and key risks. Manage payment certification, invoice generation, variation processing, and payment-application discipline across all projects. Own the final account and commercial close-out process for each project, including reconciliation, negotiation, and coordination with Finance for final payments. Lead commercial management of subcontractor and supplier packages throughout the project lifecycle, managing commercial exposure and escalations. Ensure consistent application of contractual policy, templates, and precedents across all live projects through a functional reporting line to the Corporate Contracts Department. Partner with Corporate Contracts on contractual interpretation, risk assessment of new contracts, and strategy for live claims and disputes. Lead the commercial function’s management of time and cost claims, ensuring adherence to contractual time bars and maintenance of contemporaneous records. Identify and track material commercial, contractual, claim, and cashflow risks, ensuring clear ownership and escalation routes. Produce weekly project commercial reporting packs, including project commercial decks, revenue reports, cashflow projections, and claim status for executive leadership. Establish and monitor portfolio commercial KPIs and control logs, validating data accuracy and reporting exceptions. Lead and develop the Head Office Commercial team and project commercial resources, setting performance expectations and defining career pathways. Establish effective interfaces with Finance, Project Controls, Estimation, Operations, and the Corporate Contracts Department. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in commercial management within a relevant industry. Demonstrated ability to lead commercial functions and manage project commercial delivery across a portfolio. Experience in establishing and enforcing commercial governance standards. Proficiency in managing claims, variations, and commercial risk. Strong understanding of contractual governance and interfaces with corporate contracts departments. Experience in producing executive-level commercial reports and analytics. Proven leadership skills with the ability to develop and manage commercial teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based at the IHCC head office in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to projects in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves cross-functional collaboration with various departments including Finance, Operations, Estimation, Project Controls, and Corporate Contracts. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

cf8d05b36b24d1b2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث وكالة الرياض للسفر والسياحة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، متابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل القيود المالية لضمان دقة السجلات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية وفقاً للموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عبر البطاقات البنكية أو أي وسيلة دفع أخرى. إصدار الإيصالات وفواتير العملاء وضمان تطابق المبالغ المحصلة. أخذ الاعتمادات بالصرف من المدير المباشر والإبلاغ عن أي تباين أو اختلاف للإدارة. تسوية الدرج النقدي يومياً واتباع الإجراءات الأمنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. معرفة بأساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة والقدرة على مواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد المستندات والتقارير المالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة وحفظ السجلات المحاسبية. القدرة على تحمل مسؤولية الخزن والجرد. الالتزام بالانتظام في الحضور والانصراف. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق وكالة الرياض للسفر والسياحة في بريدة، القصيم. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل المكتبي وإدارة المهام المحاسبية اليومية بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.
